say: Quick question. When the highway is half empty, your commute is easy.
caption: Quick question. When the highway is half empty, your commute is easy.

say: When it's almost full, everything crawls. Same road. What changed? How busy it is.
caption: When it's almost full, everything crawls. Same road. What changed? How busy it is.

say: That's factory loading, and cycle time.
caption: That's factory loading, and cycle time.

say: Loading is how busy you keep your slowest step, the bottleneck. A hundred percent means it never gets a break.
caption: Loading is how busy you keep your slowest step, the bottleneck. 100% means it never gets a break.

say: Cycle time is how long one order takes, from the day it starts to the day it ships.
caption: Cycle time is how long one order takes, from the day it starts to the day it ships.

say: Here's what our simulation shows. A robot needs ten minutes of real work.
caption: Here's what our simulation shows. A robot needs 10 minutes of real work.

say: At sixty percent loading, it takes eleven minutes.
caption: At 60% loading, it takes 11 minutes.

say: And at a hundred and ten percent, ninety-one minutes, and climbing.
caption: And at 110%, 91 minutes, and climbing.

say: That bend in the curve is the knee.
caption: That bend in the curve is the knee.

say: Before it, a little more work costs you almost no time. After it, every extra order makes everybody wait.
caption: Before it, a little more work costs almost no time. After it, every extra order makes everybody wait.

say: Why? Because nothing arrives perfectly smoothly. One slow job, or a crowd of orders, makes a line.
caption: Why? Nothing arrives perfectly smoothly. One slow job, or a crowd of orders, makes a line.

say: And a station that's never idle never catches up.
caption: And a station that's never idle never catches up.

say: Look at the trade. Going from ninety to a hundred percent ships about eight percent more, but cycle time more than doubles.
caption: Going from 90% to 100% ships about 8% more, but cycle time more than doubles.

say: So don't run flat out. Keep your bottleneck around ninety percent busy, and your orders keep moving.
caption: So don't run flat out. Keep your bottleneck around 90% busy, and your orders keep moving.
